title: Introducing Flint V4: improved ease of use and community templates!
summary: A major UI refresh to Flint to introduce a simplified home page, easier navigation via a sidebar, and community templates for AI tutors.
body_markdown: Need inspiration to get started with Flint? Now, with the introduction of templates, you can find examples of AI tutors that other teachers have created and shared with the wider Flint community. Search for templates to find and use one you like, or customize it to your liking.
